cell_line.evidence: HeLa VPS26C CRISPR KO cell line was previously established in the laboratory.
For GFP trap experiments using HeLa and HEK293T cells, cells were grown in 150 mm dishes and transfected the day after plating at 90–95% confluency.
For the analysis of interactomes in RPE1-hTERT cell line, each experiment was performed in three biological replicates, with two technical repeats.
The validation of interactomes in MNT1 cell line was carried out in three biological replicates.
